name: Accounts held via family members or associates
description: Funds and assets move through spouses, children, in-laws or business partners who have no obvious independent source of wealth.
fp: Families commonly share finances and businesses.

sources.text: FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)
FATF, Guidance on Politically Exposed Persons (Recommendations 12 and 22) (2013)
World Bank StAR and UNODC, Politically Exposed Persons: Preventive Measures for the Banking Sector (2010)
World Bank StAR, The Puppet Masters (2011)
